brief: The one-person newsletter stack pulling $40K/mo. 8 tools, 4 channels, zero employees.

slots.body: An 8-tool, 4-channel system that prints cash with zero employees.

slots.title: The 4 Channels
slots.body: You only need Twitter, LinkedIn, a newsletter, and a lead magnet. Post daily, email weekly, and watch compounding take over.

slots.title: Writing & Editing
slots.body: Notion handles drafts and content calendar. Grammarly polishes every sentence so you publish clean copy in minutes, not hours.

slots.title: Visuals That
slots.body: Canva Pro builds carousels and header images fast. Remove.bg cleans photos instantly. No designer, no agency, no delay.

slots.title: Email Engine
slots.body: Beehiiv sends newsletters and tracks revenue per subscriber. Buffer queues social posts across all four channels while you sleep.

slots.title: Zapier Connects
slots.body: New subscriber triggers welcome sequence. Form entries become Notion tasks. If-this-then-that logic replaces an entire virtual assistant.

slots.title: Track &
slots.body: Stripe collects payments for premium tiers. Google Analytics shows which channel converts. Double down on what pays, kill what doesn't.
Steal this exact 8-tool system and start scaling your newsletter before Monday. No hiring required.
